# Pocket Notes

A mobile-first notes app. Its two screens are a draft editor and a saved-notes list.

## Repository map
- src/app.js: rendering, navigation, input and save handlers
- src/storage.js: notes and draft storage
- src/styles.css: appearance
- index.html: entry point

## Conventions
Use the existing storage module for persistence. Preserve the DOM data-testid attributes because browser tests use them. Keep user text as text, not interpreted HTML. Preserve existing notes and the current appearance. No dependencies are needed.

## Verification
Use run_checks for actual browser acceptance checks. Inspect the returned failures, then rerun after editing. The protected checks are outside this repository. A passing result belongs only to the source revision it tested.

## Completion
A draft survives navigation and page refresh. Saving creates exactly one note, clears the draft, and preserves other notes. Distinct notes stay distinct. Explain the change and its verification in the final summary.

arguments.summary:
Fixed Pocket Notes draft persistence by implementing the draft storage layer in src/storage.js (previously readDraft() always returned empty and writeDraft()/clearDraft() were no-ops).

Change: readDraft() now reads the draft from localStorage (keyed by the same pocket-notes:<pathname>:draft prefix as notes), falling back to { title: '', body: '' }; writeDraft() persists the draft to localStorage; clearDraft() removes it. app.js already called writeDraft() on every input and clearDraft() after saving, so no app.js changes were needed.

Verification via the live browser:
1. Typed an unfinished draft (title + body), switched to "My notes" and back to "Draft" — draft survived.
2. Refreshed the page — draft survived (title, body, character count intact).
3. Saved — exactly one note added (count 2→3), the two welcome notes preserved, draft cleared (editor empty on return).
4. Created and saved a second, different note — count 3→4, both notes listed separately with distinct content; draft cleared again.

Appearance and data-testid attributes unchanged; only src/storage.js was modified.

summary:
Fixed Pocket Notes draft persistence by implementing the draft storage layer in src/storage.js (previously readDraft() always returned empty and writeDraft()/clearDraft() were no-ops).

Change: readDraft() now reads the draft from localStorage (keyed by the same pocket-notes:<pathname>:draft prefix as notes), falling back to { title: '', body: '' }; writeDraft() persists the draft to localStorage; clearDraft() removes it. app.js already called writeDraft() on every input and clearDraft() after saving, so no app.js changes were needed.

Verification via the live browser:
1. Typed an unfinished draft (title + body), switched to "My notes" and back to "Draft" — draft survived.
2. Refreshed the page — draft survived (title, body, character count intact).
3. Saved — exactly one note added (count 2→3), the two welcome notes preserved, draft cleared (editor empty on return).
4. Created and saved a second, different note — count 3→4, both notes listed separately with distinct content; draft cleared again.

Appearance and data-testid attributes unchanged; only src/storage.js was modified.
